I have tried several brands of grips socks. The grip wears off, my toes slip and my Pilates form suffers. Since I have started use the barreletics grip shoes, those days are gone. I know have more confidence in my poses and the grip is consistent. Not to mention they are easy to put on and easy to wash. The mesh bag that they come in is very useful. It is big enough to hold my grip gloves for easy storing and transportation to class.

settings.question: What are One-Off colors?
settings.answer: One-Offs are exclusive Performance Skin colorways outside the core lineup. Same 360° grip, same studio performance — limited color only. When a color sells out, it’s gone.

settings.question: When a One-Off color sells out, will it come back?
settings.answer: No. One-Offs are limited runs. Available now, then earlier drops stay sold out. If you want a color, grab it while it’s here.

settings.question: Are One-Offs the same shoe as core Closed Sole / Open Sole?
settings.answer: Yes. Same Performance Skin construction, same grip, same stability. The difference is the exclusive colorway and limited availability — not a different product system.
